rows.heading: Station Tenure Norms
rows.quote_snippet: 3.1 Minimum Station Tenure: The minimum normal tenure of an executive at any station shall be 3 (three) completed years. 3.2 Normal Rotation Window: Normal rotation of an executive shall be considered upon completion of 3 to 5 years at a work centre. No executive shall ordinarily be displaced prior to completing 3 years, except on administrative exigencies, organizational restructuring, or proven disciplinary necessity approved by Director (HR). 3.3 Technical Stint Longevity: For critical technical cadres (Drilling rig managers, Reservoir simulation specialists, Production platform heads), tenure may be extended up to 5 years by the Key Executive to ensure project delivery, drilling campaign stability, and asset integrity.

rows.heading: Definitions & Classification of Work Centres
rows.quote_snippet: (c) Category 'C' (Hard Station / Difficult / Arduous & Offshore): Assam Operational Asset (Nazira, Sivasagar, Jorhat), Tripura Asset (Agartala, Silchar), Bokaro CBM Complex, Rajasthan Basin (Jodhpur), and Offshore Platforms/Marine Production Installations (Mumbai High North/South, Neelam, Heera, Bassein, and Eastern Offshore Deepwater Kakinada).

rows.heading: Mandatory North-East / Hard Station Tenure
rows.quote_snippet: 6.1 Mandatory Prerequisite for Executive Leadership: Every executive belonging to technical and general operational disciplines must successfully complete at least one full tenure of 3 (three) continuous years in a Category 'C' Hard Station or North-East work centre (Assam Asset, Tripura Asset, Bokaro CBM, Rajasthan Jodhpur, or 14/14 Offshore Duty) prior to consideration for merit promotion from Superintending Engineer / Chief Manager (Grade E4) to Deputy General Manager (Grade E5). 6.2 Merit Review Exclusion: Executives who have not completed their mandatory Category 'C' hard station tenure shall not be empaneled in the zone of consideration for E4→E5 merit review, unless explicitly granted temporary deferment by the Executive Committee on recorded grounds of operational deployment on mission-critical national assets. 6.3 Incentives & Allowances: Officers serving in Category 'C' North-East and hard stations are entitled to Special Hard Station Allowance (10% of BP), retention of family accommodation at the last station, additional casual leave, and subsidized travel concession (STC) per TA Regulations.
